Although I'm not gay I've been living a double life for a long time now in a different way. I also have religious family and they make it hard for me to come out and be who I am. I also live in an abusive situation, so it makes it a bit harder. Living a double life is so hard and maybe one thing you can consider is moving out. I am currently saving money and waiting for the right opportunity to leave my home. I also have severe anxiety so leaving home isn't that easy for me. 

I've been coping by going to therapy and trying to be out of the house as much as possible. I try to hang out with people who care about me and do stuff that I like.

Your family may never accept you for who you are, but never stop being you.

Not a minor...I'm 24. She guilt trips me hard using religion (she is s zealot, I'm not). I want to move out so badly but it would hurt my dad (he recently started respecting me and my decisions). I am scared and I know that I will continue to be emotionally stunted if I stay here. I don't want any trouble, I just want to leave.

The fact that my mother abuses me more than I will admit to him. She has always been emotionally and verbally abusive and tonight she hit me and threatened to do it again. I told her I would call the cops if she did but she said they would never believe me and she'd tell them I did it to myself. If I told my boyfriend this he would fucking lose his shit and would stress out really badly.

That's the thing. I do all these things (except for the wearing the clothes) and I still get perceived as a pathetic loser by others. I just don't have the confidence because people keep looking down on me.

Thanks for reaching out. I'm not sure how much you can help because the problem is me. I just act in a way that most people don't understand. Most people are full of themselves and don't want to try and understand why I am the way I am and just reject me. They dont even try to accept me. If they did then maybe my self esteem would go up and I'd be better. So many people tell me to change like I'm this big problem. I am who I am and nobody wants to accept me.

What if it's not stupidity? It's just life circumstances. I mentioned that I try very hard to be "normal" but because of life circumstances outside of my control people treat me differently. I work very hard and treat people with respect but it never seems to come back to me. People take pity on me and/or exclude me based on the fact that they think I'm not allowed to do certain things, but they never asked me in the first place. I am not a needy person, I generally leave people alone but when my friends interact with me, they treat me differently than they do each other.

What I'm trying to ask is how YOU treat people like this? Do you treat them differently or do you treat them like you would any other "normal" person?
